heuristics: H1: each landing of a walk is uniform on the classes not yet visited by it, given the history, except for the closure structure (detected cycles, formal closures); the toy checks this for N up to 284746 (degenerate-fraction scaling) and N = 76880 (success runs).
H5: a closed window with a nonzero exponent coefficient has probability 1/r over the coins (independence of the coins from the path).
H7: each fresh state's key is uniform given the past; its DP flag has probability 2^-60.
H8: restart and escape exponents are outputs of a SHA-256 PRF with a random key (the standard PRF premise), used for joins, duplicates and DP overflow bounds.

H9: the square decision of a class is a random-oracle bit with expectation s = 458/1024 exactly; the square share enters in expectation over per-attack branch keys; the key-level deviation is charged by Hoeffding at delta 2^-60.

V_low = 0.7996551059 is the output of the withdrawn §9.3 expression at s = 458/1024, kept as an assumed conservative lower bound on the non-degenerate collision rate, not derived (proof.md, Section 2 and Section 5.2).
limitations: V_low is an assumption; the production collision rate is not measured, and the success claim rests on it (proof.md, Sections 2 and 5).
H1 is extrapolated from toy groups with N up to 284746 and N = 76880 (success runs) to N about 2^251.
The natural trap rate is not measured at production scale; the trap terms are the accounting values.
The 33-case kernel verification matrix passes 30 cases (the 3 failures are the cap-restart check at DP 2, proof.md Section 1); it ran on the pre-trim source and its re-run is pending.
reproduce.sh was not executed end to end; its components were run separately.
The Lemma R replay covers 768 pairs; the restart costs about 31.9 comb multiplications against the bound 32.
The sort costs are carried from the v10 sortnet measurement; the PRF cost is measured (7,851 instructions).
Memory of 2^74.321929 bytes is the enforced capacity of the distinguished-point table with its padding; it is reported, not scored.
The reference unit is priced at the organizer count (22,990 against C = 20,000); blst_fp12_mul measured 22,997.
